name: Work connection
author: Santiago Villabona (MeperDonas)
description: VPN, remote desktop and Teams for the workday, in one bar icon: state, tunnel IP and gateway, and the connect/disconnect/RDP/Teams actions.

barWidget.description: VPN state (tunnel IP, gateway) plus connect, disconnect and the work apps you have installed, driven by a helper CLI. Ships with a NetworkManager helper, and works with any other helper you point it to. English and Spanish, switched with a button in the panel header.

schema.label: Helper command
schema.description: CLI that answers the status/apps/connect/disconnect calls. Empty uses the helper bundled with the plugin (bin/work-vpn, NetworkManager).

schema.label: Status (JSON) arguments
schema.description: Tried first; if the helper does not answer JSON, the widget falls back to the text arguments for the session.

schema.label: Status (text) arguments
schema.description: Used when the helper does not understand the JSON call. The widget reads the line "VPN conectada" and the first IP.

schema.label: Connect arguments
schema.description: Arguments appended to the helper to connect.

schema.label: Disconnect arguments
schema.description: Arguments appended to the helper to disconnect.

schema.label: Apps arguments
schema.description: The helper answers a JSON list of {id,label,icon}; the widget draws one button per app. If it fails, the Remmina and Teams buttons are used.

schema.label: Open-app arguments
schema.description: Prefix used to open one app: the widget runs <helper> <open-app arguments> <id>.
